issues: src/lib/ledger.ts contains an invalid Unicode escape in the comment "\u2011character" which caused a SyntaxError preventing the module from loading. This prevents all ledger functionality from working, leading to many failing tests (e.g., export verification, backup verification, delete all data, and UI flow). The code must be fixed by replacing the problematic escape with a valid comment or string literal (e.g., use a regular hyphen or explicit Unicode escape \u2011).

src/lib/receiptStore.ts does not create a ledger entry for receipt creation (receipt.created). The requirement R5 explicitly demands an entry when a receipt is created, but the store only adds the receipt without logging. Tests that verify ledger entries for receipt creation will fail.
src/lib/mileageStore.ts (not shown) likely has similar omission for mileage creation (R8). Ensure mileage.created entries are appended.

src/lib/backup.ts incorrectly calls verifyLedger with only the store argument, but verifyLedger signature expects (store, entries?). In restoreBackup it calls verifyLedger(store, obj.ledger) but verifyLedger only defined to accept (store, entries?), causing a type mismatch and runtime error. Adjust verifyLedger to accept optional entries parameter correctly.

src/lib/exportCsv.ts builds a verification line that does not match the required format (R26). It currently outputs "<entriesCount>,<headHash>,<code12><headHash>" instead of "<entryCount>,<headHash>,<verificationCode>" where verificationCode should be first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over the CSV content without the verification line, concatenated with the headHash. The current implementation omits the concatenation rule and adds an extra headHash in the code part. Update the verification line format to match specification and adjust appendEntryForExport to store the correct code.

src/lib/exportPdf.ts records export entries using appendEntryForExport but does not include required fields format, code, entries, headHash in data as per R28. Also, the generatePdf function does not actually create a PDF file or include a verification line in the PDF, nor does it record the export entry correctly. Adjust generatePdf to compute the correct verification code, append the ledger entry with the required data structure, and ensure the PDF includes the verification line.

src/lib/ledgerVerification.ts does not correctly handle the case when the first entry is missing (it returns ok false with firstBadSeq 1 but reason "missing entry" while specification expects reason "hash mismatch" or specific messages). Also, verification requires returning firstBadSeq of the first corrupted entry - ensure proper detection of missing entry as per R41, R42, R43, R44.

src/components/ui/HistoryItem.tsx does not display the date in a human‑readable format as required by R23. It simply shows the raw ISO string. Update to format the date nicely (e.g., using toLocaleString).
src/components/ui/HistoryList.tsx (not shown) may not sort entries correctly (newest last) as required by R21 and R22. Ensure sorting by seq or at field ascending.
src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx does not call verifyLedger on mount and does not display verification status per R24/R25. Add the verification call and UI logic.

ui_flow.json primary flow step 26 cannot find the "History" button (test failure). The UI component likely does not expose a visible button with label "History". Ensure the receipt edit screen includes a button with accessible label "History" that navigates to ReceiptHistoryScreen.

src/lib/ledgerHelpers.ts initLedgerIfNeeded imports receipts and mileage but does not set the correct 'at' import date for each imported entry (spec wants at set to import date). It also may not set prevHash correctly for the first imported entry after existing ledger entries. Verify correct prevHash handling.

src/lib/ledgerHelpers.ts and related functions might not delete or clear ledger entries when "Delete all data" is invoked, violating R14. Ensure that deleteAllData clears the ledger and resets ledgerSeqCount.
feedback: Many ledger-related functions are broken or missing, causing backup, export, verification, and UI flow tests to fail. Fix the syntax error in ledger.ts, ensure receipt and mileage creation, correction, and deletion all log appropriate ledger entries, implement import-on-first-launch correctly, correct export verification line format and ledger entry data, add verification UI, and adjust UI flows to expose History button. Update ledger verification to meet spec's error detection. After fixing these, re-run tests.
